text_post: I have questions to pose to everyone.  Keep in mind I'm bisexual.  The whole gay marriage thing has been pissing me off as of late because of the push that it's the final frontier for "marriage equality".  I can't marry more than 1 woman, or 1 man, or 1 of each, so it's only marriage equality for monogamous couples.  Completely disingenuous imo not that I really want to but options right?  So it got me thinking after fighting on facebook with people who won't even acknowledge that religious polygamists, polyandrists, bisexuals like me, communal group partnerships and the like don't have marriage equality; what would divorces look like with same sex couples on the large scale.   Most of us have issues with today's climate when it comes to marriage.  With hypergamy, the cleaners, court mandated child support that goes to supporting the ex ect. What happens when gays and lesbians start seeing massive wealth transfer, ugly child custody battles and the endless stream of bullshit heterosexual men get?   Will it even happen?  There some happening now, but it's pocket change at this point. Will the courts discriminate against a female identifying as male in a court proceeding?   Will a problem with unequal treatment in the courts even be acknowledged if there is one?   Will anything change for hetero men in divorces?? And what effect would issues with gay divorces have on men in general? Will there suddenly be large numbers of gay MGTOWs? If anyone else has any hypotheticals pile on.

author: AnAlias
text_post: RE: Hypergamy and Wealth Transfer One of the biggest issues to come out of gay marriage (or rather gay divorce) is the issue of child support. I believe there have been cases already where homosexual couples who adopted or had a donors have split and the one left with custody went on to seek child support from the biological parent(s). Only way to see how this kind of stuff will resolve itself is to see more cases of it though. So "only time will tell".
